label: Compromised CEO mailbox — off-register style
narration: The CEO's mailbox sends a crore-sized request — but the writing is not his. The stylometric twin catches what no voice check can.
raw_text_or_transcript:
From: Vikram Shah <vikram.shah@meridiansteel-in.example>
To: priya.menon@meridiansteel.example
Subject: ACQUIISITION DEPOSIT — TIME SENSITIVE!!
Reply-To: treasury-desk@meridiansteel-in.example

Hi Priya,

We are transferring Rs 1.8 crore to Global Trading FZE today! This is the acquisition deposit. Account ADCB0000099281.

Send it now! The deal team is waiting.

I am in back-to-back calls so only email me. Do not copy anyone on this mail. This is board-level and highly confidential.

Regards,
Vikram
